papers.s1: A fair, gentle test of lessons 1-3 with no wrong answers, but the small pool shows: the 对不起/没关系 exchange appears four times (Q8, Q23, Q35, Q40), the reading part replays the listening dialogs, and six words are tested twice (vocabulary or listening, then writing). Reading and grammar are very easy for anyone who sat the listening, and the echo replies (你好→你好, 再见→再见) need no understanding. Acceptable as a practice quiz, not yet as an exam.
papers.final: Much improved: it reads like a real HSK 1 final, options are clean, and almost no item has two right answers. What remains is repetition across parts (对不起/没关系, 三本书, 十八块钱, 明天我给你打电话) and some lopsided coverage: reading has 21 judge items to 10 text items, five of the 13 handwriting words are lesson-5 family words, and several lessons have no hear, pick or handwriting item. Grammar is a little easy because the same answer often comes twice in a row (是, 的, 在).

findings.reason: Filed under lesson 1, but '对不起，我不会说汉语。' needs 会, 说 and 汉语 from lesson 6; only 对不起 is understood, and only option A starts with 'Sorry'.
findings.suggest: Tag the sentence lesson 6, or use a lesson-1 sentence such as 对不起！/ 没关系。

findings.reason: '你的___很好。' is unnatural (a name is 好听, not 很好), and 名字 is the only noun among 是/吗/叫, so it is chosen by word type alone.
findings.suggest: Drop this fill or rewrite it as 你叫什么___？ with noun distractors (老师, 学生).

findings.reason: 'A：对不起！ B：___。' is the exchange heard in Q8, which asked for the same 没关系.
findings.suggest: Never use a grammar blank whose exchange was heard as a dialog in the same paper.

findings.reason: '___客气' is a split of the word 不客气, which vocabulary Q18 and Q19 print as an option and as an answer.
findings.suggest: Do not split a set phrase that an earlier part tests as a whole word; drop the blank when 不客气 is a vocabulary item.

findings.reason: The text '我不是老师。' is the sentence of grammar blank Q28.
findings.suggest: One use per sentence per paper, across parts.

findings.reason: '对不起！' → '没关系。' is the third time this exchange appears (Q8, Q23).
findings.suggest: Cap each exchange at one appearance; when the pool is too small, prefer fewer items to a repeat.

findings.reason: The right reply '你好！' repeats the prompt '你好！' word for word, and the exchange was already heard in Q9.
findings.suggest: Remove echo replies (answer identical to prompt) from the reply pool.

findings.reason: The right reply '再见！' repeats the prompt, and the exchange was already heard in Q11.
findings.suggest: Remove echo replies from the reply pool.

findings.reason: The text is the 对不起/没关系 exchange for the fourth time (Q8, Q23, Q35).
findings.suggest: Do not use a text whose lines repeat an exchange already used in the paper.

findings.reason: The last line '不客气，再见！' is the sentence of grammar blank Q26.
findings.suggest: One use per sentence per paper, across parts.

findings.reason: Six words are tested twice: 没关系 (Q18, Q43), 对不起 (Q14, Q44), 您 (Q15, Q45), 谢谢 (Q2, Q46), 吗 (Q17, Q47), 叫 (Q20, Q50).
findings.suggest: When relaxing the one-test-per-word rule, prefer untested lesson words for handwriting (你们, 名字, 学生, 什么, 人, 是) before repeating.

findings.reason: In '很___！' the wrong options 您/你/你们 are all pronouns and 好 is the only adjective, so word type gives the answer.
findings.suggest: Use adjective distractors that do not fit (大, 多, 热 are fine only if wrong in context), or drop this fill.

findings.reason: 'A：对不起！ B：___。' is the exchange heard in Q24 ('对不起！/ 没关系。').
findings.suggest: Never use a blank whose exchange is a listening dialog in the same paper.

findings.reason: '那个杯子十八___钱' tests 块 in the same frame as fill Q73 '这个杯子十___钱'.
findings.suggest: Treat the answer word of fill and blank as one tested word; never test it twice in a paper.

findings.reason: '桌子上有三___书' tests 本 in the same frame as fill Q75 '我有三___书' (same pair as in round 2).
findings.suggest: Same as above: one test per answer word across fill and blank.

findings.reason: '13 = ___' repeats the skill of Q89 '20 = ___' in the same part, with the same digit-swap distractors.
findings.suggest: One number-reading item per paper.

findings.reason: '明天我___你打电话' comes back as judge Q126 '我明天给你打电话' and text Q152/Q153 '明天我给你打电话'.
findings.suggest: Do not pick a text or judge sentence that is a blank sentence elsewhere in the paper.

findings.reason: The right reply '再见！' repeats the prompt word for word, so it needs no understanding.
findings.suggest: Remove echo replies from the reply pool.

findings.reason: '下午你去哪儿？' is the same question as Q138 '你去哪儿？' in the same part, and '我去商店' answers both.
findings.suggest: Never put two reply items with the same question pattern in one part.

findings.reason: Options mix Chinese '美国/中国' with English 'Both' and 'We don't know', so the two English options are ruled out by type.
findings.suggest: Keep one language: 中国 / 美国 / 英国 / 日本.

findings.reason: Tiles 这|写|汉字|怎么|个 also make '怎么写这个汉字？', as natural as '这个汉字怎么写？'.
findings.suggest: Accept both orders or exclude this sentence from order.

findings.reason: '我有一个小猫' uses 个 where the measure word for a cat is 只.
findings.suggest: Use 我有一只小猫 (with pinyin on 只) or 我家有小猫.

rules: Treat a whole exchange (both lines) as one sentence for the no-repeat rule, so 对不起/没关系 cannot come back as a dialog, a blank, a reply and a text; when the pool runs out, ship a shorter part rather than a repeat.
Count the answer word of fill and blank as a tested word together with meaning, pick, hear and hand, so 块, 本 and 不客气 are tested once; prefer an untested word from the same lesson before relaxing.
Remove echo items from the pool: replies identical to their prompt (你好→你好, 再见→再见) and blanks that split a set phrase tested elsewhere (___客气).
Wrong options in fill must be the same word class as the answer (no pronouns around an adjective answer), and text options must be in one language.
Balance kinds within a part (judge 21 against text 10 in the final) and spread handwriting and hear items across lessons, at most two per lesson.
